title.zh: 投行分析师的那份初稿

premise.zh: Rogo 面向金融机构做分析 agent：处理研究流程里重复的取数与初稿环节。
premise.en: Rogo builds analysis agents for financial institutions, aimed at the repetitive retrieval and first-draft parts of research work.

narration.zh: 这里的工作不是「回答问题」，而是把一份初稿做到可以被人接手修改。
narration.en: The job is not answering a question. It is getting a draft to the point where a person can take it over.

input.zh: 一个研究问题，加上该用户有权限的文档范围
input.en: a research question and a permitted document set

output.zh: 相关的财报、材料和电话会记录，范围限定在该用户可见的部分
output.en: the relevant filings, decks and transcripts, scoped to what the user may see

output.zh: 与问题相关的具体数字和表述
output.en: the specific figures and statements that bear on the question

output.zh: 结构化初稿，每条结论都挂着它的出处
output.en: a structured draft with each claim attached to its source

output.zh: 由分析师修改并署名——agent 不负责发布
output.en: an analyst edits and signs off — the agent does not publish

narration.zh: 选一个场景，看这套流程替代掉的具体是哪一段。
narration.en: Pick a situation to see which stretch of work this actually replaces.

situation.zh: 周一早上要交一份行业对比的初稿。
situation.en: Owes a first-pass sector comparison on Monday morning.

outcome.zh: 初稿变成审阅对象，而不是从零开始的写作任务。
outcome.en: The draft becomes something to review rather than something to start from nothing.

situation.zh: 需要确认模型只接触了该用户有权限的材料。
situation.en: Needs assurance the model only touched material this user is cleared for.

outcome.zh: 权限在取数阶段生效，而不是在输出阶段过滤——这决定了这类产品能不能进机构。
outcome.en: Permissions apply at retrieval, not as an output filter — which is what decides whether this can enter an institution at all.

narration.zh: 示意对话，说明产品的工作方式，不代表真实界面。
narration.en: An illustrative exchange showing how the work flows. Not a real interface.

text.zh: 对比这四家公司在最近两次业绩电话会里怎么描述价格压力。
text.en: Compare how these four companies described pricing pressure in their last two earnings calls.

text.zh: 已根据八份记录整理出初稿，每处描述都链接到它来自的原文段落。
text.en: Draft assembled from the eight transcripts, with each characterisation linked to the passage it came from.

text.zh: 其中一家不在我的权限范围内。
text.en: One of those wasn't in my entitlements.

text.zh: 那家公司在取数阶段就被排除了，初稿会写明这一点，而不是默默只讲三家。
text.en: That company was excluded at retrieval, and the draft says so rather than quietly covering three.

text.zh: 关于折扣的那个说法出自哪里？
text.en: Where does the claim about discounting come from?

text.zh: 它对应到具体某一段原文。如果那段原文支撑不了这个说法，该删的就是这个说法——所以初稿给的是链接，不是断言。
text.en: It resolves to a specific passage. If the passage does not support it, the claim is the thing to cut — which is why the draft carries links rather than assertions.

evidence.claim: Rogo raised a $160M Series D; adoption reported among large financial institutions.
